subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should maintainers require live Telegram owner-session delivery proof before merging this session-routing change, or accept source tests and CI only?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but the affected behavior is a visible Telegram delivery path and the Mantis proof workflow was skipped, so automation should not decide the proof bar alone.

options.title: Require live owner-session proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing completion delivery to the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge on source and regression-test evidence, but they own the remaining real transport/session delivery risk.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the background-task, ACP, and subagent completion wakes folded into one explicit delivery contract first.

recommendation.title: Require live owner-session proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal output, or linked artifact showing completion delivery to the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest available routing candidate from recent task/subagent completion history for deciding whether the source proof is enough.
